requirement: The system shall allow authorized clients to retrieve the user list and create users over HTTP. It shall validate the supplied access token before either operation and reject requests that fail validation without performing the protected action.

The system shall retrieve stored LwM2M client security information from an Ethereum-compatible blockchain through Web3j over HTTP. If contract access fails, it shall record the failure and return an empty result without propagating the exception to the caller.

The system shall store client endpoint identifiers and bootstrap-server and management-server connection and security settings in a smart contract, and retrieve the corresponding bootstrap configuration by endpoint. String values exchanged with the contract shall use its fixed 32-byte ASCII-compatible representation.
The system shall accept LwM2M node data in JSON form, convert valid data into Leshan/LwM2M node and resource representations, and reject structurally invalid input.
